items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser suits oily and sensitive-looking skin without stripping it.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable, smoother-looking surface and helps with low-looking moisture.
A mineral SPF 50 helps shield fair skin from daily sun, which is the simplest step for keeping fine lines from looking worse.

response.routine_note: I have left out retinol products because they are not appropriate during pregnancy, so please check any anti-aging plans with your doctor or midwife. Use the cleanser morning and night, follow with moisturizer, and apply the mineral SPF every morning.
